fields.description: Issue includes editorials and commentary on Miami policing priorities (traffic enforcement vs. burglary), congestion and bus operations, and a serialized publication of the 1925 bus operating agreement between the City of Miami and the Miami Beach Railway/Florida Power & Light interests. Contains a satirical allegory tracing a dollar’s circulation in Miami, discussion of Florida East Coast Railway rate issues and competition with the Seaboard, letters/comments on Miami banks’ lending practices, coverage touching the Miami Jockey Club and an injunction suit, and regular features including a bridge column and local society/entertainment notes and advertisements.
